images.name: 07_the_court
images.final_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape 16:9 concept image for a co-op hide-and-seek horror game. The whole level is ONE gigantic soft-play frame filling a round hall 155 metres across, steel truss roof 42 metres up. Exact centre: round open court 25 metres across with blue-and-green checker foam puzzle mat floor, painted yellow ring and short red padded post. Around it 360 degrees is a tall steep curved WALL of twelve walkable netted galleries, 34 metres tall, leaning back only slightly: four storeys straight up from the court edge, narrow 4-metre ledge, four more storeys, narrow 4-metre ledge, four more storeys. Clearly three groups of FOUR gallery openings vertically. NOT wide stadium steps, not circular staircase terraces. Frame continues densely behind the face to the hall wall. Every gallery has yellow/red/blue/green vinyl padded steel posts, black knotted safety netting, coloured mat decks, square red panels with round clear bubble windows, crawl tubes and punch bags. Glossy tube slides each ONE solid bright colour. No bare hall, no other attractions, no arcade machines, no neon, no inflatables, no ball pit, no watermark, no HUD or UI, no lettering or text, no people or animals. Only include the Counter doll where explicitly requested.

Photoreal concept art matching reference 1 owner_ref's worn materials and dim dusty abandoned quiet mood; reference 2 tall_walls supplies sheer steep height; reference 3 doll_counting supplies exact Counter pose and reference 4 doll supplies identity. Sparse cold white fluorescent strips overhead, bright pool at centre, long shadows, light haze and dim upper storeys. Camera stands at edge of court, wide lens looking across and UP to roof. Centre under brightest light: yellow floor ring, short red padded post, beside it the Counter, a 2.3m porcelain ball-jointed child doll, cracked pale porcelain, party hat, striped shirt, dungarees, BOTH hands over eyes counting exactly as doll_counting. It is a doll, no human people. Show full twelve-storey height of galleries all around, narrow ledges after floors 4 and 8. Solid orange and solid blue tube slides hang down face into court, TWO net bridges cross high overhead, dark gateways open at floor level. A few loose plastic balls. No text.
Critical architectural correction: make ALL TWELVE storeys individually readable, exactly 12 rows of full-height walkable netted bays from floor to roof. Make two narrow projecting walkways clearly visible, one immediately above row 4 and one immediately above row 8; each separates a four-storey vertical wall section. Preserve towering steep silo geometry. Do not reduce floor count to 9 or 10. Fit entire wall height in frame.
images.weakness: Two ledges are clearer in the accepted retry, but the floor count and exact 4+4+4 grouping remain inaccurate.

images.weakness: The high viewpoint reads well, but the exact eleventh-storey position and 30-metre drop cannot be verified visually; ledges are understated.
